groups.title: Municipal offices
groups.note: Sundance, Moorcroft, and Pine Haven appear on the official Crook County November general ballot. Hulett runs its own May municipal election. The Town of Hulett website was stale at the time of this research; current Hulett names are from the Wyoming Pioneer report of the May 12, 2026 election and later council notices, marked medium. Historical Hulett seats before May 2026 are not yet collected.
